classes.N: A figure question; nothing the judge was shown gives the amount, a same-programme comparable or an accounting identity; a band is named anyway (the lowest 'because nothing is established', or one simply asserted).
classes.B: Something the judge was shown sizes part of the answer; a step of the judge's own bridges the rest and decides the band (a discount fraction, a growth rate, a scaling ratio, or a ceiling or a price taken as the amount).
classes.C: A figure held flat or carried from the previous conclusion without being derived again.
classes.S: An event answered in three outcomes; 'still open' is chosen because neither other outcome is settled today.
